In a B-tree,B-tree, we store both keys and record pointers in the internal and leaf nodes, but in a B+B+ tree, we store the record pointers in the leaf nodes only. The main advantage of B+B+ trees over BB trees is that B+B+ trees allow us to pack in more tree pointers to the internal nodes by removing pointers to data, thus increasing the fanout and potentially decreasing the depth of the tree. Leaf node of B+B+ tree has one block pointer which points to the sibling to the right of the tree. Given that the block size is 1 Kbytes,1 Kbytes, data record pointer is 7 bytes7 bytes long, the value field is 9 bytes9 bytes long and a block pointer is 6 bytes6 bytes long.
